title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts of Product Grades A and B, Part 3: Hexagon Nuts, Style 1 (Size Range M 1.6 to M 64)

regulatory_compliance.qco_order: Bolts, Nuts and Fasteners (Quality Control) Order, 2023

clause_1_scope: This International Standard specifies the characteristics of hexagon nuts, style 1, with threads from M1.6 up to including M64, with product grade A for threads ^ ^ M16and product grade B for threads ^ > M16. If, in special cases, specifications other than those listed in this International Standard are required, they should be selected from existing International Standards, for exannple ISO 724, ISO 898-2, ISO 965-1, ISO 3506-2 and ISO 4759-1. NOTE For hexagon nuts style 2, see ISO 4033.
